author: Kusha N M
raw:
ಕೊಡುವಜನರಿಹರೆಂದು ಹೀರಿಬಸವಳಿಸದಿರು
ಪಡೆದಧನ ಸಮಯಗಳ ಬೆಲೆಯನರಿಯುತಿರು
ತಡೆಯುತಲಪಮೌಲ್ಯ ಉಳಿಸುವೆಡೆ ಗಮನವಿರೆ
ಕೊಡುವಾತ ಸಹಕರಿಪ ಮೂಢಮನುಜ

lines: Just because there are people who give, don’t drain them dry;
know the value of the money and time you receive;
if you prevent loss of value and are mindful of saving,
the giver will help you, O deluded one.
en.bhavartha: Don’t exploit generous people. Value what you are given, whether money or time, and use it carefully. Givers help those who show responsibility.
